# BoostedBudget

> BoostedBudget is a budgeting platform that connects your accounts, automates routine budgeting work, and runs a remote MCP server so your AI agent can work with your finances.

BoostedBudget is a GDPR-compliant personal budgeting platform. It offers user-defined automation rules, envelope budgeting, savings goals, and spending analytics, and it never moves money.

The MCP server lets MCP-compatible clients read across your accounts, transactions, budgets, and portfolio. Every change an agent proposes waits for your explicit confirmation, credentials are injected server-side and never visible to the agent, and access can be revoked at any time.
